narration: Your net worth number might be off by six figures — and it's not your fault. Here's the math behind the illusion that's quietly wrecking your retirement plan.
visual: Person silhouette at a glowing laptop showing '$500,000'. The number pulses, then a bold red 'FAKE' stamp crashes down over it with a spring animation.

narration: Number one: your 401k balance. If yours says $400,000, that's not your money yet. The IRS takes 22 to 32 percent on withdrawal — up to $88,000 gone before you spend a dollar.
visual: Piggy bank labeled '401K' springs in. An amber bar fills to '$400,000'. A red section peels off showing 'IRS: $88,000' (22%). Green label 'YOU KEEP: $312,000' appears below.

narration: Number two: your home equity. You see $180,000 — but selling costs 8 to 9 percent in agent fees and closing costs. That's $16,000 that never actually hits your account.
visual: House SVG with '$180,000 EQUITY' label. A suited agent figure walks in and carries away a money bag labeled '$16K'. Updated label reads '$164,000 REAL VALUE' in green.

narration: Number three: your car. You wrote down $28,000 — but it lost five grand last year and four this year. It's not an asset. It's a melting ice cube on your spreadsheet.
visual: Car SVG on a light background. A year counter advances (Year 1 → Year 2 → Year 3) while the value ticks down from $28,000 to $19,000. Ice cube icon melts beneath the car.

narration: Add those adjustments up and your $500,000 paper net worth drops to around $370,000. That's a $130,000 gap between what feels true and what actually is.
visual: Table animates in row by row: 401K ($400K → $312K), Home Equity ($180K → $164K), Car ($28K → $19K). Totals appear: PAPER $608K vs REAL $495K. Red box highlights 'GAP: -$113,000'.

narration: The fix is simple — track your after-tax, after-cost net worth instead. Free apps do it automatically. Your real number is smaller, but it's the only one your retirement plan can count on.
visual: Phone with budgeting app showing after-tax values in green. Bold text: 'TRACK YOUR REAL NET WORTH'. Checkmark badge springs in. Follow prompt with green circle appears.
